questions.question: Reconcile the ~0.3% non-gold revenue (gold = 99.7% of Group revenue) and quantify by-product revenue deducted from operating costs in the AISC definition.
questions.evidence_required: Segment revenue split (gold vs by-product/non-gold) for FY26 and FY25 in US$ and %, plus the by-product credit amount deducted in the AISC reconciliation.
questions.closure_condition: Segment revenue confirms gold share and the by-product credit quantum is identified and ties to the AISC build; benign explanation accepted if immaterial.

questions.question: Identify which operations comprise the lower-cost (247,219 oz @ US$1,702/oz) and higher-cost (25,154 oz @ US$3,487/oz) AISC buckets and confirm the allocation ties to segment and production data.
questions.evidence_required: Mine-level AISC and oz sold for FY26/FY25 reconciling to the 247,219/25,154 oz and US$420.686m/US$87.718m totals; note any reclassification between buckets.
questions.closure_condition: Mine-level costs sum to the bucket totals and the bucket membership is stated; forecast consequence for blended AISC noted.

questions.question: Quantify the items excluded from net (cash)/debt and net senior debt (IFRS 9 adjustments, restricted cash, financial liabilities) and reconcile to the statement of financial position.
questions.evidence_required: Borrowings/lease note figures for each excluded item in US$, and a reconciliation of net debt and net senior debt to D005 statement of financial position balances.
questions.closure_condition: Each exclusion is quantified and the reconciliation to the primary statement balances; benign explanation accepted if immaterial.

questions.question: Identify the amount of capital expenditure funded through permitted indebtedness deducted in the free cash flow definition and the relevant facilities.
questions.evidence_required: Capex-funded-by-debt amount in US$ for FY26, the facility names, and the FCF reconciliation showing the deduction.
questions.closure_condition: Amount and facility identified and FCF reconciliation ties; forecast consequence for FCF vs conventional definition stated.

questions.question: Trace the actual headline earnings reconciling items (disposal of PPE, impairments, bargain purchase, tax effect) per SAICA Circular 1/2023 and confirm the HEPS reconciliation.
questions.evidence_required: Itemised headline earnings adjustments with tax effects in US$ and the HEPS/basic EPS reconciliation for FY26 and FY25.
questions.closure_condition: Each adjustment is quantified with tax effect and reconciles to HEPS; forecast consequence for normalised earnings noted.

questions.question: Identify non-gold operations' sustaining and development capex excluded from AISC and confirm it is captured in total group capex.
questions.evidence_required: Non-gold capex amount in US$ excluded from AISC and its inclusion in the PPE/capex note totals.
questions.closure_condition: Non-gold capex quantified and reconciled into total capex; benign explanation accepted if immaterial.
